depth_history.shortcut_targeted: It is guaranteed that at least one critical triad exists.
depth_history.edit_summary: Remove the existence guarantee and add: if no critical triad exists, print 0 0 0; otherwise print the lexicographically smallest critical triad.

resistant_to: Uses the existence promise to search only for the first found triangle, with sorted neighbor traversal for lexicographic order.
Uses bitset adjacency and searches for a common neighbor, with no handling for an absent triangle.
Checks each edge for a third vertex adjacent to both endpoints and assumes such a witness will be found.
Sorts edges and searches for the smallest common neighbor, relying on a triangle being present.
